mechanism: Tricyclic antidepressants like nortriptyline can impair renal potassium excretion and increase serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those concurrently using ACE inhibitors or NSAIDs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically; assess renal function and concurrent medications; educate patient on potassium-rich food moderation and report symptoms of hyperkalemia (weakness, palpitations, arrhythmias).
